reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: No issues. Cheap, easy, no nonsense. Great for a cheap but quick nvme.
reviews.author: Carlo Moreno

reviews.title: WD Blue SN5100 2TB NVMe SSD - M.2 2280, PCIe Gen 4.0
reviews.comment: Not too much I can say other than it arrived overnight and was installed in 5 minutes. It works fine. The read/write speed is what I needed and I have used WD products in the past. They are reliable. Also WD has a 5 year warranty on the NVME and that IS a plus. Well worth it!
reviews.author: Roy Ayres

reviews.title: Very fast hard disk.
reviews.comment: Installation was straight forward.  The computer recognized the new drive, partitioning and formatting were as with any other drive.  I did need to separately purchase the correct screws and spacers to properly secure the SSD to the motherboard.  Works great, no issues.
reviews.author: John D. Evanoff II

reviews.title: Western Digital Blue Series Nv.Me SSD Drives
reviews.comment: This is a solid performing super fast SSD Nv.Me.  I highly recommend anyone needing massive storage in an Nv.Me SSD purchase this drive.  Runs cool.and is Super Fast.  Western Digital Blue are solid SSD drives.
reviews.author: Thomas
